author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Why I said Claude Code itself is a giant AI slop?  It doesn't update its built-in release note.   The latest version of Claude Code is 2.1.265, but the built-in release note is still at 2.1.191

In the pre-AI era, if a software always missing the release note, you know you can't trust that piece of code.
